reference: Halloween (S2E5): Michael is a two-headed man (a papier-mache second head he sent away for from a catalog); Dwight is a Sith Lord (hood and lightsaber, cost $129); Jim is a 'three hole punch version of Jim' (three paper circles taped to his shirt); Pam is a cat.

evidence.line: Michael: Happy Halloween, everyone! [notices Pam, in her cat costume]
Pam: [notices Michael's costume] Papier-mache? ... Michael: I know. I sent away for it in July from a catalog. [bobs his head around, causing the costume head to jiggle around]
Jim: I'm a three hole punch version of Jim... Dwight: I am a Sith Lord. ... Three round pieces of paper taped to a shirt. This cost me 129 dollars.
Michael: Well, I don't really have two heads. So...

caveats: Largely visual; the transcripts name Dwight's, Jim's and Pam's costumes explicitly. Michael's is inferred from 'I don't really have two heads', 'Papier-mache?' and him talking to 'the fake head' (sc.14): a two-headed man costume. Accept 'two-headed man / man with a fake second head'. 'Dwight as Darth Vader' is not what he says (he says Sith Lord); treat a generic 'Star Wars Sith' as correct, 'Darth Vader' as partial.
question: What costumes do Michael, Dwight, Jim and Pam wear in the Season 2 Halloween episode?
